The structure of Ca5Cu3SbO12 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 21 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca, Cu, and Sb centers each coordinated by six oxygen neighbors, with Cu–O distances of 1.9526–2.0559 Å, while O centers adopt tetrahedral or five-coordinate environments. Corner-sharing is observed between tetrahedral and five-vertex O polyhedra, as well as among tetrahedra and between tetrahedra and five-vertex polyhedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
